title: Sea Blessings | Scenic Stays
meta_description: Sea Blessings- A Beautiful 4 Bedroom Home Steps from Seacrest Beach!
description_expanded: Experience Sea Blessings, an ideal vacation home in Seacrest Beach ready to accommodate a crowd. Conveniently located near the 30A corridor, Sea Blessings is close to everything the area offers, including land and water activities, dining and entertainment, and, of course, the beach. Breathe the coastal air, relax on the front porch, and sip a cool drink while taking in breathtaking sunsets along Florida’s Gulf Coast! Sea Blessings is a stunning home with four bedrooms and four baths accommodating up to eleven. Professionally decorated and grand by all accounts, the beautiful finishes and elegant touches in this luxurious home invite you in for a unique experience. A lovely front porch welcomes you with plentiful seating around a gas fire pit, the perfect spot for sharing the day’s adventures. Plush furniture awaits in the living room with seating for all to convene for a movie on the large, built-in flat-screen TV. Gather around the extended dining table or at the breakfast bar for meals and snacks. Floor-to-ceiling windows bring in plenty of sunshine and filtered light, quietly encouraging the outdoors inside. The fully appointed kitchen, equipped with top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, affords plenty of counter and cabinet space and a Keurig coffee pot for your morning brew! The first floor showcases a master bedroom with a king-size bed with an en suite bathroom and a full-size washer and dryer for added convenience. Two additional master suites, beautifully decorated, spacious, and with king-sized beds, await on the second floor. Extra seating, wall-mounted TV(s), en suite bathroom(s), and a private balcony are just a few of the features you’ll find here. Enjoy incredible views from the private balcony on the third floor, which also houses a custom-built bunk room accommodating four, and an additional bathroom. You’ll also find a wet bar, mini-refrigerator, 75” flat-screen TV, Gaming Console, and board games the kids will love! Take a dip in the 12,000 sq. ft. award-winning pool, walk to neighboring shops and restaurants, or explore nearby Rosemary Beach. In Seacrest Village you can walk or text for a tram pickup to the beach. You’ll be on the sand in no time! Parties and events are strictly prohibited and guests under 25 must be accompanied by an adult chaperone throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden and pets are unfortunately not welcome and subject to immediate departure if found to be inhabiting a property. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund. Experience your coastal getaway in style and comfort at Sea Blessings in Seacrest Beach today! Please Note: Seacrest Beach does NOT allow golf carts in their community. Bicycles are not included with your stay. However, rentals are available at the entrance of the property. Because we want you to enjoy your stay, we’ve added an OK2Charge EV charger. Before your stay, you will receive an activation email to register for the service or simply scan the QR code on the face of the charger when you arrive.
